Vivian enters and the bracelet gets caught in the gap between the door and the wall as the door shuts. VIVIAN(feigning surprise)Wow, what happened? Zane clenches the ring in his hand, turning. LEMONFine, since you look down on me so much, let’s get divorced. ZANEDivorce? You have no say in this marriage? Zane takes a document from the desk and slaps it on her. ZANE(cont'd)This agreement, your father signed with me. He was ready to trade you for two hundred million and give away 15% of Chase Group’s shares. Lemon is shocked, flipping through the document. LEMON(choked up)No... no, this can’t be true! Zane squats in front of Lemon, holding her chin and coldly smirking.

ZANE (mocking smile)To him, you're just a trophy doll. He only sees you as someone to marry off. Lemon pushes him away, choking. LEMONNo, you’re lying! Zane looks down at her, wiping his hands with a handkerchief. ZANEHow pitiful, Lemon. You have nowhere to go but my place. Zane throws the handkerchief on her face, turning away. ZANE(cont'd)Vivian, teach her the company rules. Tell her not to go where she doesn’t belong!

Could she have figured out that Mr. Sterling is Ethan? A car horn honks and Lemon stops and turns around at the sound. The car approaches and Lemon freezes, looking up to meet Zane’s gaze through the window. [Slow motion]: The car passes by, and the two lock eyes for a brief moment. LEMON(in shock)What is Zane doing here? The wind blows the poster even farther, and Lemon looks away, continuing to chase after it in the opposite direction. The two continue on their separate paths, growing further apart. Zane watches her retreating figure in the rear-view mirror, getting smaller and smaller.
INT. CAFÉ - DAY89 89

IVY (V.O.)If I can convince Zane that I’m the "Leia" he’s looking for, then my brother and I will be at the top. Maybe I can even get his company. The sound of wind chimes jingles as the door opens. Ivy turns her head to see Zane push open the glass door and walk toward her, anxious. Ivy gulps and stands up, exchanging a glance with Mark, who gives her a slight nod. Zane rushes over to Ivy, his gaze intense as he scans her up and down, grabbing her wrist and inspecting it. [Close up]: The E is carved into the bracelet.

ZANE(excitedly)Leia, it’s really you! Zane looks at her, then pulls her into a tight embrace, his voice trembling. ZANE(cont'd)Leia, I finally found you! Where have you been? I’ve been looking for you for so long. Ivy and Mark exchange a look. Ivy lifts her hand to hug Zane back. IVYI missed you so much. Zane releases her and grabs her hand. ZANE(concerned)Have you been okay all these years? IVY(forcing a smile)I’ve been well. Look, I’m right here in front of you! Ethan, I need to use the restroom.
INT. CAFÉ CORNER - DAY90 90

Ivy turns to leave for the restroom. Ivy opens her phone and sees a message from Mark in a dark corner. MARK (O.S.)Ivy, don’t slip up. Lemon is also in Winter Town. If Mr. Sterling finds out her true identity, we’re finished! IVY(frowning, typing)No way. You need to deal with Lemon. She’s a ticking time bomb!
INT. CAFÉ - DAY91 91
Zane sits at a table while Mark stands nearby, texting.

MARK (V.O.)(sends message)Kill Lemon. I’ll pay five million. ZANEMark, what are you doing? Mark looks up in a panic and hides his phone. MARKNothing. I was just chatting with my sister. Do you need anything? Ivy walks back over from the restroom. Zane stands up with a bright smile, excited. ZANE(beaming)Today, I’m going to take Leia back with me. Mark, get the house at Joyland ready for her! MARK(shocked)Joyland? That property is worth billions! MARK (V.O.)If Ivy successfully impersonates her, we’ll get everything we want.
EXT. WINTER TOWN ROADSIDE - DAY92 92

Lemon is Walking down a small alley. She hears somebody calling her name from behind. THUG 1Lemon? Lemon turns around, only to be confronted by a GROUP OF THUGS holding sticks. LEMON(nervously)Who are you? She turns to flee, but MORE THUGS appear behind her, some drinking from bottles. THUG 1(coldly)Never mind. You should think about who you’ve pissed off!

LEMON(frowning)Did Vivian send you? The thugs exchange glances. Lemon panics and looks around. She spots a small path to the right and makes a run for it. Thug 2 grabs her and pulls her into his arms. LEMON(cont'd)(struggling)Let go of me! THUG 1(grabbing her hair)Bitch! You think you can run? Not a chance! [Close up]: Thug 1 laughs and raises the bottle to smash it toward Lemon. LEMON (O.S.)(screaming)Ah—!
EXT. WINTER TOWN ROADSIDE - DAY 93 93
THUG 1Drag her away! Lemon, bleeding from her forehead, scrapes at the dirt with her hand.
Two thugs grab her by the shoulders and pull her up.
CUT TO:
EXT. IN FRONT OF ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY 94
location: EXT IN FRONT OF ABANDONED FACTORY

text: The thugs throw Lemon on the ground of an abandoned factory. THUG 2(dusting off his hands)Boss, this girl looks pretty. THUG 1(slaps him on the chest)I know you!

Thug 2 grins, licks his lips and bends down to approach. Lemon opens her eyes and sits up. LEMON(warily)What do you want? Thug 2 reaches to grab her. LEMON(cont'd)(frantic, shoving him)Get off me! Don't touch me! Thug 2's smile falters. He raises his hand and slaps Lemon hard across the face. She adjusts her hearing aid. THUG 2(snarls)You filthy bitch, still resisting! Watch out! Thug 2 lunges at Lemon Chase, ripping at her clothes. She desperately clutches her chest. LEMON(screaming)Please, let me go! I'll give you anything! Help, someone, please help me! Thug 2 grabs a rag from the floor and shoves it in her mouth, tearing open her shirt. THUG 2Look at her soft skin... Lemon struggles in agony.
INT. IN THE CAR - DAY95 95
Zane and Ivy sit in the backseat, Zane holding Ivy’s hand. ZANEWhere have you been these years? I searched for so long. But it’s okay now, everything’s over. IVYYeah... yeah...

ZANE(studying her)When I woke up in the hospital fourteen years ago, I couldn’t find you no matter what. Did you get hurt back then? IVY(shaking her head)No. I’ve been doing okay these years. Just missed you a lot. ZANE(relieved)That’s fine. Zane looks at her fingers. ZANE(cont'd)Leia, haven’t you been practicing the violin all these years? IVY(confused)What violin? ZANE(blinks, confused)You used to play the violin. I remember you had thick calluses on your fingers back then. IVY(curling her fingers)I got busy with school, so I stopped playing. I barely remember how to play now. ZANE(disappointed)Oh. I have treasured a violin for you, and I thought maybe I’d get to hear you play that song again. IVY(pulling her hand away)It’s been so long, I’ve forgotten. Zane watches her hand, confused. ZANE (V.O.)Why is Leia being so distant from me? Could she be lying?
ZANE(testing her)Leia, do you remember why I gave you this bracelet? IVY(nervously)I... I don’t remember. ZANE(clenching his fist)You’re lying! You’re not Leia!
INT. IN THE CAR - DAY 96 96

Ivy lowers her head, her eyes flickering. MARKBoss. It’s been so long. Leia might have forgotten. Zane pulls at Ivy’s left wrist, but she struggles, hiding it behind her back. IVYPlease, believe me! I forgot! Don’t do this, I’m scared! ZANE(angry)Mark, throw her out of the car! Ivy looks at Mark, who sighs in resignation.
CUT TO:
EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY 97 97

Ivy standing by the side of the road as the luxury car speeds away. IVY (V.O.)(clenching her fists)No... I can't give up! Ivy turns around, her steps halting as she’s shocked. [Close up]: The camera pans from her feet up to reveal Vivian’s face, wearing a baseball cap.

IVYIt’s you? VIVIANIvy, you played me, didn’t you? IVY(nervously)I don’t understand. Ivy starts walking past Vivian, but Vivian grabs her arm. VIVIANThat bracelet is Lemon’s! She’s the one Zane’s been searching for! Vivian’s eyes drop to Ivy’s wrist, and she pokes her shoulder. VIVIAN(cont'd)And you want to impersonate her and take my Zane, don’t you? IVY(deflated)I don’t care about Zane. All we want is money. So what do you want? VIVIANI’ve been thrown out. But I’m not giving up! I need you to help me win Zane back! IVY(resigned)Deal.
EXT. IN FRONT OF ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY98
location: EXT IN FRONT OF ABANDONED FACTORY

text: Thug 2 is on top of Lemon. She grabs a brick and smashes it into his head. Thug 2 yelps in pain, covering his forehead as he falls. THUG 2 Damn it! You bitch! You can’t get away! Thug 2 gets up and grabs Lemon’s hair. Lemon grabs his hand, pushing it away. THUG 2 (cont'd)Let go of me!

Thug 2 grits his teeth and presses her head to the ground, forcing her face down. THUG 2(cont'd)Bitch! I will teach you a lesson today! LEMONNo... please... help me... Zane’s car drives past the factory. He sees the thugs surrounding Lemon and sits up, tense. [Slow motion]: Lemon’s tear-filled and her pained eyes lock with Zane's in the car. ZANE(eyes wide in shock)Lemon...?
EXT. ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY101 101
THUG 1I don’t know! We’re lackeys. As for who she pissed off, I— I have no idea.

ZANEMark, take them to the police station! MARK(relieved)Yes. Zane crouches beside Lemon, picking her up and glancing down at her in his arms. LEMON(looking at him)Thank you. Zane lifts Lemon into the car, and they drive off.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY102 102

Lemon lies with her eyes closed in the hospital bed. Zane sits beside her, looking at her in confusion. Mark stands behinds Zane. ZANELemon, why were you in Winter Town? MARK(Urgently interject)I’ve asked the nurse. Mrs. Sterling went there with no special purpose. As for those thugs, they’ve been causing trouble. ZANE(frowning)I see. Mark turns to leave, but Zane stops him. ZANE(cont'd)Wait. Why was the bracelet is on that woman’s wrist? What’s going on? MARK(uneasy)Didn’t you confirm the bracelet already? Why are you still doubting?

ZANE(frowning) )Leia would never forget the reason I gave her that bracelet. Go and conduct a thorough investigation for me. MARK(nodding and leaving)Yes. MARK (V.O.)I have to find out what happened to make sure Ivy can replace her. Zane looks down at Lemon’s hand exposed from under the blanket. He reaches down to touch it but freezes in shock as he notices a scar on her wrist. [Close up]: Lemon’s left wrist shows the scar.
By the creek, Lemon looks down at the bracelet on her left wrist, wiping away tears with her right hand.

LEIAI fell when I was little and my hand landed on broken pieces of a bowl. I didn't want to hurt myself! ETHAN(smiling)I know! With this bracelet, no one will laugh at you anymore! LEIA(smiling)Yeah, it'll cover my scar. Thank you, Ethan!
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY103 103
Zane’s eyes well up, looking in disbelief at the unconscious Lemon. ZANEOh God, she also has the scar, does that mean Lemon is the Leia?

ZANE (V.O.)(smiling fades)But why did you become deaf? What happened? Lemon mumbles in her sleep, and her brow furrowed. LEMON(waking up, gasping)Help me... No! ZANE(holding her left hand)You’re awake. Lemon is covered in sweat. Zane steps forward, pulls her into his arms, and pats her back. Lemon tenses up. Zane looks down at her, comforting her. Lemon looks at her hand held by Zane, she pulls away in surprise. LEMONWhy are you holding my hand? ZANE(sitting down, asking)Can you tell me how you got this scar on your wrist? LEMON(confused)I broke a bowl when I was little and landed on some shards. Why do you ask? ZANE(excited, smiling)Did someone give you a bracelet when you were little, saying it would cover this scar? Lemon’s eyes widen in shock, staring at Zane. LEMON(sighs sadly)How do you know? A boy gave me a bracelet... But I lost it... ZANE(overjoyed, asking)What was that boy’s name?
LEMONHis name is—
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY104 104
ZANE(excited)That boy’s name?
CUT TO:
INT. OUTSIDE OF HOSPITAL WARD - DAY105 105
Mark listens at the door, recording on his phone. LEMONHis name is—
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY106 106

Mark rushes in. ZANE(irritated)Who let you in? MARK(turns off phone)I am sorry, but you have an emergency call. ZANENot now. Zane looks back at Lemon. ZANE(cont'd)Go on. MARK(urgent interrupting)Sir, it’s important. Zane listens to Mark's whisper. His face darkens. LEMON(smiling)We’ll talk later.
Zane pats her head, nods, and exits with Mark.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY107 107
Nurse enters with a hearing aid. NURSELemon? Lemon nods. NURSE(cont'd)Your husband had this custom-made. Want to try? Lemon smiles, takes it. LEMONYeah. Thank you. LEMON (V.O.)He's so considerate.
INT. THE HOSPITAL HALLWAY – DAY108 108

Zane answers his phone, walking fast. Ivy, in a hospital gown, bumps into him, dropping a bracelet. ZANE(frowning)You okay? Ivy grabs the bracelet, murmuring. IVYEthan gave me this... I can’t lose it. She looks up, stunned. IVY(cont'd)Ethan? Zane frowns, reaching for the bracelet. ZANEGive it to me. Ivy hides it, voice shaking.
IVYIt’s been with me for fourteen years. You don’t get to take it! Zane grabs her wrist, noticing a scar. [Close-up] His face pales.
INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY - DAY109 109

Zane stares at Ivy’s wrist, voice shaking. ZANEHow do you have that scar? IVYFourteen years ago, I told you I got it from a broken bowl. Don’t you remember? ZANEBut last time I asked— IVY(smirks)I lost my memory after an accident. Didn’t even remember you. Zane's expression flickers. ZANESo that’s what happened... IVY(tears up)I thought you had someone else. That’s why you left me. Ivy suddenly starts hitting her head. IVY(cont'd)It’s all my fault! Zane kneels, pulling her into an embrace. ZANEIt’s okay. I should’ve recognized you.
Ivy smiles in his arms.
INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY - DAY110 110
Ivy grabs a shard of a broken bowl, slicing her wrist. MARKAre you sure? IVYA scar can change my fate. It's worth it.
INT. HOSPITAL HALLWAY - DAY111 111
Ivy clings to Zane’s arm.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY112 112
Lemon watches Zane holding Ivy closely, passing by through the open door of the ward, frowning. LEMONYou...
CUT TO:
INT. ANOTHER HOSPITAL WARD - DAY113 113
Zane tucks Ivy into bed. ZANERest up. I’ve got work. IVY(small pout)Stay with me? ZANE(rubs her head)I’ll be back soon. Zane leaves. Ivy's smile fades. She dials on the phone.
IVY(coldly)Vivian, I did what you said and he believes the scar.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY114 114

Zane walks into Lemon’s room. They lock eyes. LEMONWho is she? Zane clenches his fist, gaze dropping to Lemon’s wrist. ZANE (V.O.)If Leia’s real... Lemon’s scar must be a coincidence. ZANEIt’s none of your business. LEMONI'm your wife now. Even if we're in a contractual marriage, I still have the right to know. Zane swallows hard. His eyes flicker.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY115 115

Lemon smirks, arms crossed. LEMONNo need to explain. I get it. ZANE (V.O.)Why am I still so nervous, I should have to double-check the bracelet thing. ZANE(firm)Who gave you that bracelet? LEMONNot your business. Zane's expression hardens.

ZANEFine. LEMONLeave me alone! ZANEWhat’s wrong with you? He turns and about to leave. LEMON(cold)You've got a new love, so we should have divorced earlier. I want to get out of the hospital and go back to packing. ZANE(gritted teeth)I’ll have someone take you out of the hospital tomorrow. He slams the door.
EXT. STERLING MANSION - DAY116 116
A luxury car pulls up. Servants bow as Zane steps out with Ivy.
EXT. STERLING MANSION - DAY117 117

A luxury car pulls up. Servants bow as Zane steps out with Ivy. SERVANTSMr. Sterling! ZANEThis is Ivy Stone. Treat her well. IVY(smiling)This is my friend. Vivian, in a veil, stands beside her. IVY(cont'd)She has scars. Don’t stare.

Zane eyes her suspiciously. ZANEShe looks familiar. IVYShe’s from the different town. You’ve never met her. Zane shrugs and leads Ivy inside. Vivian watches, eyes gleaming. VIVIAN (V.O.)Lemon, your time here is up.
INT. STERLING MANSION HALLWAY - DAY118 118

Vivian enters, spotting Lemon on the stairs. Ivy clings to Zane’s arm. IVY(tired)Zane, I’m a bit tired. Take me to our room. ZANE(nods)No problem. They walk past Lemon. Lemon grabs Zane’s arm. LEMON(quiet, hurt)You brought her home? We’re still husband and wife. Zane shoves her away. ZANEWho are you to question me? LEMON(smirks)Right… what was I expecting? She wipes her tears and walks upstairs. Zane clenches his fists, watching her go.
INT. STERLING MANSION KITCHEN - NIGHT120 120
Vivian stirs white powder into the milk, handing it to Ivy. VIVIAN(to Ivy)Make sure he drinks it. If I can’t have his heart… I’ll have his body.
INT. STERLING MANSION - MASTER BEDROOM - NIGHT121
Zane sways, gripping his head. ZANE(frowning)Why do I feel... dizzy? Ivy supports him. IVYYou must be exhausted. Lie down. She helps him onto the bed, turns off the light, and exits.
CUT TO:
Moonlight streams in. The door creaks open. A woman in high heels enters.

ZANE(dazed)Who’s there? Vivian walks over, touching Zane’s face. VIVIAN(whispering)Finally… you’re mine. Zane grips her wrist, eyes widening. ZANE(shocked)Vivian? Vivian unbuttons his shirt, pulling at his tie. VIVIANYou’re burning up. Let me take care of you. She leans in, but Zane shoves her off. She crashes to the floor. ZANE(angry)Get. Out. Vivian scrambles up, reaching for his belt. Zane slaps her hard, then stumbles toward the door.
INT. STERLING MANSION - LEMON’S BEDROOM - NIGHT122
Lemon wipes tears from her cheek, staring at herself in the mirror. She exhales, resigned. Suddenly, the door bursts open. Zane stumbles in, panting. Their eyes lock.
INT. STERLING MANSION - STUDY - DAY133 133
Vivian, Mark and Ivy in the study.

VIVIANThere’s a drug that’ll destroy her inner ear. Once she leaves, she’ll die outside like a stray dog. MARKYou’re drugging her? VIVIANShe’ll get a new hearing aid, right? Just slip it in. No one will know.
INT. STERLING MANSION - LEMON’S BEDROOM - DAY134
Mark smirks as he watches Lemon hold the hearing aid. MARK (V.O.)Lemon, this time, you won’t escape.
INT. STERLING MANSION - STAIRS - DAY135 135

Lemon heads downstairs but suddenly clutches her head. LEMON (V.O.)Why does it hurt? SFX: A sharp ringing noise. Her vision blurs. Blood drips from her right ear. LEMON(panicked)Blood? She collapses against the railing. Vivian and Ivy step forward, smirking. LEMON (WEAKLY)(cont'd)You… did this to me…? Vivian kicks her down, smiling coldly. VIVIANYou won’t survive this. LEMON (V.O.)Not now… I have to tell Zane…

LEMON(whispers)Help me… Ivy and Vivian laugh. IVYNo one’s coming. VIVIANGive me the drug. Ivy hands her a bowl of dark liquid. LEMON(panicking)What are you doing?! VIVIANHold her. Ivy pins Lemon down. Vivian grabs her chin, forcing the medicine down her throat. VIVIAN(cont'd)Stop fighting. Vivian shoves her down the stairs.
CUT TO:
INT. STERLING MANSION - HALLWAY - DAY136 136
Dona gasps as she finds Lemon lying at the bottom of the staircase.
INT. STERLING MANSION - HALLWAY - DAY137 137

Dona gasps, looking up to see Ivy and Vivian standing at the top of the stairs. IVYIs she dead? VIVIANBetter if she is. But don’t worry, the drug will make her mute even if she survives. Dona covers her mouth in shock, then bolts away.
VIVIAN(cont'd)That’s what you get for taking Zane from me.
INT. STERLING HOUSE STUDY - DAY138 138
DONA (40s), shaking, rushes into the study —right into Zane. DONA(anxious)Young Master! ZANEWhat’s wrong? DONAIt’s Ms. Stering—she fell down the stairs! ZANEWhat?! Zane sprints toward the staircase.
INT. STERLING MANSION - HALLWAY - DAY139 139

His face drops when he sees Lemon lying there, bleeding from her ear. ZANELemon! His hands tremble as he touches her bloodied face. ZANE(cont'd)Wake up! He turns to Dona, furious. ZANE(cont'd)Call an ambulance! Now!
INT. HOSPITAL - DAY140 140
Zane runs alongside the gurney in which Lemon is lying. ZANELemon, stay with me!

A nurse blocks his path as the doors to the operating room shut. NURSESir, please wait outside. Zane halts, fists clenched, watching as the “IN SURGERY” light flicks on. Zane paces. Finally, the surgical light turns off. The doctor steps out, removing his mask. ZANEHow is she? DOCTORShe lost a lot of blood. Her hearing aid may have been faulty. We’ve sent it for testing. ZANEThe hearing aid? DOCTORYes, but we’ll know more soon. She’s stable for now. Zane exhales, relieved. ZANE (serious)Can you check her medical records for a tumor? DOCTORI’ll need to run tests. But… there’s no tumor on her CT scan. Doctor leaves Zane stiffens.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY141 141
Zane sits beside Lemon’s bed, watching her sleep. ZANE (V.O.)Did Ivy lie? But the test results…
INT. OUTSIDE OF HOSPITAL WARD - DAY142 142
Ivy lurks.

IVY (V.O.)(smug)You survived, but now you can’t hear or speak. Feels like hell, doesn’t it? Hurried footsteps approach. Ivy hides as the doctor walks past, holding a CT scan. DOCTOR(sighs)She really does have a brain tumor… Ivy’s eyes widen. IVY (V.O.)What?! I was bluffing… but it’s true? Ivy sneaks away as the doctor enters the room.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY143 143
DOCTOR(somber)Mr. Sterling, I was wrong. She does have a brain tumor. Zane’s face darkens as he stares at the report. ZANEWhat?!
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY144 144

The doctor hesitates, adjusting his glasses. DOCTOR I’m sorry. We’ll plan the best treatment for Miss Chase. ZANE(points at the door)Please leave! The doctor leaves. Zane stares at Lemon, unconscious. ZANE (V.O.)Why did you lie to me again?
Zane storms out, slamming the door behind him.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY145 145

Zane enters, placing the divorce papers on the table. He sits beside Lemon, who wakes up, eyes brightening. She tries to speak, but only a rough sound comes out. Panicked, she touches her throat and ear. LEMON (V.O.)Why can’t I speak?! ZANEYour throat’s injured. Give it time. Lemon watches his lips, then remembers. LEMON (V.O.)It was Ivy and someone else! ZANEWhat are you trying to say? Lemon shakes her head, grabbing her phone. LEMON (V.O.)I have proof! If he sees my childhood photo, he’ll know! She finds the picture of her and her father, smiling. LEMON (V.O.)Found it! She shows Zane her phone.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY146 146

Lemon holds up her phone, ready to show Zane. A stack of papers lands on her lap—blocking the screen. She stares at the divorce agreement, then up at Zane. ZANELet’s divorce. Her hands tighten around her phone. ZANE(cont'd)I’m marrying Ivy.

The phone slips from her grasp. She forces a bitter smile. ZANE(cont'd)What were you trying to show me? Lemon closes her eyes, turns off her phone, and shakes her head. LEMON (V.O.)If he wanted to believe me, he already would have. She sighs, reaches for a pen, and signs the papers. Zane takes them. Outside, Ivy watches through the window, smirking.
INT. OUTSIDE OF HOSPITAL WARD - DAY147 147
IVY (V.O.)Finally. Lemon is finished.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY148 148

Subtitle: Ten days Later Lemon sits on the bed, wearing a hearing aid. A nurse enters with a tray. NURSEYou’re making progress. Try speaking a little. LEMON(throat hoarse)Thank… you. The nurse hands Lemon a test result. NURSEI have good news for you. You’re pregnant! LEMON(stunned)What?!
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT149 149

Lemon touches her abdomen, lost in thought. LEMON (V.O.)Should I tell him? But he’s marrying someone else… The door creaks open. A woman steps in wearing a headscarf and a scar. Close-up: A knife in her hand. VIVIANWhy are you still alive? LEMON(backing away)Who—? Vivian rips off her headscarf and fake scar. LEMON(cont'd)(terrified)Vivian?! VIVIAN(smiles coldly)You thought I was dead? She lunges with the knife. Lemon shields herself, trembling. The door slams open.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT150 150
ZANE(shouting)What are you doing?! Vivian grabs Lemon, pressing the knife to her throat. ZANE(cont'd)(realizing)You’re Ivy’s ‘friend’… VIVIAN(smirking)So what? Zane steps forward.

VIVIAN(cont'd)Don’t move! One more step, she dies! LEMON(weakly)Zane… help… Vivian tightens her grip. VIVIANYou never loved me! You chose her! ZANE(strained)Put the knife down, and I’ll forget everything. VIVIANForget? I’ve loved you for years, and you never looked at me! She glares at Lemon. VIVIAN(cont'd)I’ll let her go—if you promise me something. ZANE(slowly)What? VIVIANMarry me. A voice interrupts from the door. IVY (O.S.)Zane! Zane, Vivian, and Lemon turn to look.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT151 151
Zane steps forward, grabbing Vivian’s wrist. The knife clatters to the floor. He twists her arm behind her back as Lemon stumbles free, gasping for air. IVY(running in)What’s going on?!

VIVIAN(struggling)Let me go! ZANE(yells)Mark! Mark enters, exchanging a quick glance with Ivy. MARKBoss! ZANETake her away. Lock her up! Mark and Ivy move toward Vivian, grabbing her shoulders. VIVIAN(fighting back) )Let go of me, you two liars. If it wasn't for my help, do you think you guys could have fooled Zane so easily? Zane’s eyes widen. ZANEWhat do you mean? Mark and Ivy freeze for a split second. Ivy quickly slaps Vivian across the face. IVYStop lying! I treated you like a sister, and this is how you repay me? VIVIAN(snarling)You two have been scamming Zane all along! You're brother and sister! MARK(dragging her)Enough! ZANE(hesitates)Wait! Mark and Ivy stiffen as Zane turns to Vivian.
ZANE(cont'd)What do you mean... brother and sister? What have they been deceiving me about?
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT152 152

VIVIAN(eyes red)Ivy and your assistant. They’re lying to you! She’s not Leia! (pointing at Lemon)Lemon Chase is the Leia you’vebeen searching for all these years! IVYNonsense. MARKI don't even know Ms. ivy. LEMONThey are lying! Ivy stole my bracelet, assumed my identity, and faked my tumor. ZANEEnough! He throws the CT scan at her. ZANE(cont'd)Look at your results! Lemon’s hands tremble as she reads. CLOSE-UP: DIAGNOSIS RESULT - BRAIN TUMOR, SIZE 2cM X 3cM. LEMON(shaken)No... This can’t be right... ZANEThe doctor confirmed it.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT153 153

IVYI get it, you two are teaming up, neither of you want to be abandoned. Ivy pulls out an ultrasound of Lemon's pregnancy. IVY(cont'd)You must've planned this. I see your B-ultrasound slides. Are you ready to say your baby is Zane's. Lemon stares at him, eyes burning. ZANEWhat the hell is going on? Whose baby is it? Lemon exhales. LEMONThink. Whose baby could it be? There was no one else that night but you. Lemon’s voice turns hollow. IVYIt can't be Zane's. You bitch. The baby could have been conceived in Winter Town. LEMONI'm Leia and the baby's yours.
